source_title: Sun Pharma to Acquire Concert Pharmaceuticals
source_locator: Joint January19 release opening and Transaction Terms and Timeline to Closing
review_notes: Sun Pharma and Nasdaq-listed Concert announce a definitive tender offer for all Concert common shares, followed by a second-step merger. The consideration is USD8 cash plus a nontradeable contingent right for up to USD3.50, conditional on later sales milestones. The proposed ownership is the whole company; no contingent payout or closing is asserted. Date-only announcement timing; exact earliest dissemination remains unaudited. Actual review occurred in2026.

source_title: Fusion Pharmaceuticals to be Acquired by AstraZeneca
source_locator: March19 issuer release opening, Financial Considerations and wholly owned subsidiary statement
review_notes: Nasdaq-listed Fusion announces its definitive acquisition by AstraZeneca. The statutory plan of arrangement covers all outstanding shares for USD21 cash plus a USD3 contingent cash right tied to a regulatory milestone. The announcement remains distinct from later shareholder approval, regulatory clearance and completion. Date-only announcement timing; exact earliest dissemination remains unaudited. Actual review occurred in2026.

source_title: Merck to Acquire Harpoon Therapeutics, Further Diversifying Oncology Pipeline
source_locator: January8 joint release opening and all-outstanding-shares transaction terms
review_notes: Merck and Nasdaq-listed Harpoon announce a definitive agreement covering all outstanding Harpoon shares for USD23 cash per share. This is a whole-company merger even though Merck describes its accounting treatment as an asset acquisition. Closing remains subject to shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. Date-only announcement timing; exact earliest dissemination remains unaudited. Actual review occurred in2026.
